description: Determinate progress by default; indeterminate for a wait with no percentage.

progressPercentage.description: How far along, 0-100. Clamped and rounded. Ignored when `indeterminate`.

indeterminate.description: A wait with no percentage; the bar sweeps instead of filling.

label.description: Names what is progressing. Drawn above the bar, and it is the bar's accessible name.

showPercentage.description: Shows the percentage beside the label. Determinate only.
